templates.name: Classroom
templates.tagline: Warm paper, deep teal and sunny amber: a clear, friendly lesson deck.
templates.best_for: Teaching anything step by step: school lessons, staff training, workshops, onboarding modules and explainers. Has slides for objectives, a key definition, three building blocks, a worked example, a comparison, a big fact, an activity, a quick quiz and a recap.
templates.avoid_for: Sales pitches, investor decks and moody brand storytelling: it reads as a classroom by design.

templates.name: Daisy Days
templates.tagline: Cheerful pastel deck with hand-drawn daisies, stars, and rainbows. Friendly, soft, and warm.
templates.best_for: Lessons and workshops for children and families, community sessions and friendly kick-offs: has slides for a welcome with four points, five columns of short items, a numbered schedule, four cards, three steps, a quote, four people, and a goodbye.
templates.avoid_for: Investor, board or corporate decks, and anything with a lot of numbers: the daisies and rainbows read as a classroom for young learners.

templates.name: Status Report
templates.tagline: Crisp white and slate with indigo and traffic-light status pills: a working review deck.
templates.best_for: Reporting where work stands: project and program status, QBRs, steering committees, board and weekly updates. Has slides for an executive summary with an overall status, four KPIs, a workstream status table, a milestone timeline, progress bars, a risk table, decisions needed and next steps with owners and dates.
templates.avoid_for: Inspirational keynotes, lifestyle brands and anything that should feel playful.

templates.name: BlockFrame
templates.tagline: Neobrutalist deck with pastel-neon color blocks and chunky black borders.
templates.best_for: Project kickoffs and plans: the goal, the scope, the phases, the team and the numbers to hit, in a bright, friendly, bold style. Has slides for an overview with three cards, three cards, a quote, a four-phase timeline, four big figures, a team of up to six and a closing.
templates.avoid_for: Formal board or investor decks, research talks and quiet or sombre subjects: the thick outlines and candy colours are playful by design.

templates.name: Storefront
templates.tagline: Cream, espresso and terracotta with a golden accent: a warm small-business sales deck.
templates.best_for: Selling a product or service from a small business: cafes, shops, studios, agencies and local services pitching customers or partners. Has slides for the problem, three offerings, how it works, why us, three price tiers, a testimonial, proof in numbers, an offer and a contact close.
templates.avoid_for: Formal finance, research reports and technical reviews.

templates.name: Grove
templates.tagline: Forest-green canvas with cream type, classical Playfair serifs, and a single rust accent.
templates.best_for: Anything that should feel organic, considered, and grown-up: sustainability and wellness brands, outdoor / nature products, wineries and restaurants, literary or arts decks, advisory deliverables, bilingual EN/CN reports. Also a calm, distinctive choice for tech, research, or business decks that want patience over urgency.
templates.avoid_for: Decks that need neon energy or rapid-fire pop — the forest-green canvas and Playfair serif commit to a slow, classical voice.

templates.name: Capsule
templates.tagline: Modular pill-shaped cards on warm bone with a full pastel-pop palette.
templates.best_for: Sales and marketing plans, campaign and launch plans, brand and social media plans for small businesses and creators: three pillars, a five-phase plan, four target figures, a channel flow, a statement and a closing, with soft colourful pills.
templates.avoid_for: Formal board, financial or research decks: the floating pills and pastel gradients read as playful.

templates.name: Emerald Editorial
templates.tagline: A magazine-cover business deck: emerald + navy + paper, double-rule masthead ornaments, and a bold Bodoni-style display serif.
templates.best_for: Also school and college presentations on history, society or current affairs (a war, a freedom movement, an election) that should feel serious. Anything that should feel like the front of a serious magazine, including but not limited to leadership readouts, planning-office reviews, and strategy briefings. The double-rule masthead ornament gives it editorial gravitas without making it stiff — also a great unexpected pick for product launches or research recaps that want to feel considered rather than corporate.
templates.avoid_for: Contexts that need to read as quiet, neutral, or institutionally restrained — the emerald field is too saturated to disappear into the background.

templates.name: Monochrome
templates.tagline: Ivory ledger paper with all-black type; Lora serif headlines, Jost body, no color at all.
templates.best_for: Research and academic talks: seminars, thesis defences, user-research readouts and policy briefs, in a quiet, typeset style. Has slides for a key finding, three figures with sources, a numbered list, a two-column comparison, a participant quote, a discussion in two columns, a four-step method, a dated timeline, a cycle, a five-level hierarchy and a closing.
templates.avoid_for: Student and group projects, school presentations, celebrations, children's lessons and loud sales pitches: it is a quiet, text-led research style.

templates.name: Coral
templates.tagline: Cream and coral on near-black, set in oversized Bebas Neue.
templates.best_for: Anything that should feel warm-graphic and editorial: fashion, beauty, fitness, F&B, lifestyle brands, agency credentials. Just as strong for a creator portfolio, a manifesto, or a tech / research deck that wants warmth and a single bold accent instead of corporate cool.
templates.avoid_for: Contexts that should feel quiet or institutional — the coral accent and oversized Bebas Neue commit hard to a confident magazine voice.

templates.name: Retro Zine
templates.tagline: Beige paper with green accent and Bebas Neue + Caveat: a riso-printed zine in HTML form.
templates.best_for: Recipes, food and drink menus, cooking classes, cafés and small food businesses, in a warm printed-zine style: four facts at a glance (prep, cook, serves, difficulty), ingredients and method in two columns, three numbered steps, four tips, a quote and a closing.
templates.avoid_for: Formal corporate, finance or research decks: the paper grain, stamps and handwritten accents read as homemade.

templates.name: Studio
templates.tagline: Black canvas with electric-yellow type; high-voltage design studio aesthetic.
templates.best_for: Anything that should feel electric and design-led: studio credentials, creative agency pitches, brand showcases, art-direction reviews, fashion / sneaker brand work. Also a striking unexpected choice for tech, research, or business decks where the speaker wants the deck to *be* a brand statement.
templates.avoid_for: Contexts that should feel quiet or institutional — the black-and-electric-yellow palette is the loudest in the library.

templates.name: Broadside
templates.tagline: Dark editorial canvas and full fire-orange slides with massive lowercase grotesque type.
templates.best_for: Manifestos, founder and vision talks, product strategy and design talks, campaign launches and startup stories: a huge title, a chapter opener, a one-line claim, three big figures, a section divider, four rules, a quote, a before and after, a four-step process, a five-level pyramid, a four-event timeline, a four-step loop and a sign-off, on black and fire orange.
templates.avoid_for: Quiet, warm or institutional decks, and anything that needs charts: the dark and orange slides commit to drama, and the sample charts are not offered.

templates.name: Biennale Yellow
templates.tagline: Solar yellow on warm parchment with deep indigo serif and soft sun-glow gradients.
templates.best_for: Exhibition and festival programmes, arts and cultural seasons, lecture series and event calendars, studio reviews and publication launches: a cover with dates, a one-sentence statement, a five-item programme list, a chapter opener, a curator's quote, an eight-row calendar table and a thank-you colophon, set in indigo serif on yellow and parchment.
templates.avoid_for: Data-heavy business, finance or sales decks: there is no offered chart or figures slide, and the one-yellow palette is quiet by design.

templates.name: Creative Mode
templates.tagline: Cream paper with bold green, pink, orange and yellow blocks and Archivo Black display.
templates.best_for: Creative agency pitches, design studio and brand reviews, workshop kickoffs and product concepts: a poster title, a section opener with three short paragraphs, four figures in coloured blocks, a four-layer stack, a four-step process, a three-option comparison table and a big thank-you, in saturated blocks with heavy black outlines.
templates.avoid_for: Formal, financial or institutional decks: the saturated multi-colour blocks read as expressive, not restrained.

templates.name: Editorial Tri-Tone
templates.tagline: Dusty pink, mustard and deep burgundy in a magazine layout, set in Bricolage and Instrument Serif.
templates.best_for: Magazine and editorial pitches, fashion, lifestyle and hospitality brands, community spaces and studio stories: a cover with a cloud of tag pills, an opening note, eight principles, a five-stop timeline, a quote with three testimonials and a colophon with four columns, in pink, mustard and burgundy.
templates.avoid_for: Data-heavy or formal corporate decks: the big figure and chart slides hold sample data and are not offered, and the tri-tone is deliberately styled.

templates.name: Mat
templates.tagline: Dark sage canvas with bone-cream cards and a burnt-orange accent; mid-century and tactile.
templates.best_for: Product launches and briefs, design studio credentials, craft, furniture, interiors and architecture brands, and advisory decks: a title with a cream info card, a claim with three bullets, three big figures, a quote, a four-point list on cream, a before and after, and a closing with a contact card, on dark sage.
templates.avoid_for: Fast tech energy or bright, playful decks: the muted sage and burnt-orange palette is slow and warm; the image and chart slides are not offered.

templates.name: Vellum
templates.tagline: Deep navy canvas with warm-yellow Cormorant serifs and a single dusty teal accent: a quiet, scholarly look.
templates.best_for: Also history and literature talks for a class, told calmly. Essays, reflective talks and research or advisory findings that should feel calm and literary, with few words per slide in large serif type. Has slides for a single-claim statement, an observation with a paragraph, three findings with figures, four numbered rules, a quote, a before-and-after comparison and a closing line with an email address.
templates.avoid_for: Dense data decks, sales pitches and anything that needs energy or colour: the navy and yellow serif look is deliberately slow and sparse.

templates.name: People's Platform
templates.tagline: Activist poster energy: cobalt blue, signal orange and red on cream, with Alfa Slab and a brush script.
templates.best_for: Also awareness talks on a cause for school or community (saving water, climate, health, safety). Campaigns, causes and plans that should sound loud and honest: civic and community decks, nonprofit updates, manifestos, founder visions and bold team plans, in a protest-poster style. Has slides for a contents list of up to eight sections, a one-sentence big idea, three priorities, one big figure, an eight-item plan, a customer quote, a four-step roadmap with three target figures, a today-versus-proposed comparison and a closing.
templates.avoid_for: Formal board, finance or academic decks and anything quiet or soothing: the saturated poster palette and slab type commit hard to expressive energy.

templates.name: Scatterbrain
templates.tagline: Pastel sticky notes pinned to cork and paper, with Shrikhand titles and Caveat handwriting.
templates.best_for: Brainstorms, workshops, retrospectives and classroom or club projects that should feel like ideas pinned to a board. Has slides for a big quoted statement with a side note, two columns with checklists, three lettered ideas, a three-phase timeline, a before-and-after comparison and a closing with small notes.
templates.avoid_for: Formal board, finance or research decks: the sticky notes and handwriting read as unfinished on purpose.

templates.name: Playful
templates.tagline: Sun-warm peach background with Syne display and hand-drawn doodles: a friendly indie launch deck.
templates.best_for: Small businesses, freelancers and creative studios introducing themselves, indie launches and friendly workshops, in a warm peach style with sketchy outlines. Has slides for a six-item agenda, a big statement with two short paragraphs, five offerings, a five-step process, three big figures and a closing with contact lines.
templates.avoid_for: Formal board, finance or research decks and anything that must look institutional: the peach palette and doodles read as casual.

templates.name: Bold Poster
templates.tagline: Editorial poster look with massive Shrikhand display type and a single fire-engine red accent.
templates.best_for: Company overviews, founder visions, brand manifestos and agency pitches that should land like a magazine cover. Has slides for a big quote on red, an executive summary with three highlight figures, one huge figure with three smaller ones, four services with bullets, a four-phase roadmap, three numbered principles, four locations or teams and a huge closing word.
templates.avoid_for: Quiet, gentle or children's topics: the giant red display type is loud by design, and its denser slides need real figures to fill them truthfully.

templates.name: Pink Script — After Hours
templates.tagline: Near-black canvas, hot pink accent and pearl-cream DM Serif Display headlines: late-night editorial luxury.
templates.best_for: Fashion and luxury brand decks, launches, nightlife and spirits brands, creator brands and seasonal reports that should feel nocturnal and luxe. Has slides for a five-section index, five key figures, a section divider, a five-step process, a comparison table against two rivals, a quote and a closing with three next steps.
templates.avoid_for: Daytime corporate, B2B, school or healthcare decks: the black canvas and hot pink read as styled and after-hours.

templates.name: Stencil & Tablet
templates.tagline: Bone paper with stencil-cut headlines and a six-colour earth palette: a field manual for a brand.
templates.best_for: Agency and brand strategy decks, client proposals, research findings and manifestos that should feel bold and hand-made. Has slides for a four-item agenda, four principles, a section divider, a detailed three-column finding, a five-step process, a comparison table, three key figures, a client quote and a closing with three next steps.
templates.avoid_for: Soft, quiet or delicate subjects and formal finance or board decks: the stencil capitals and saturated earth tones are loud by design.

templates.name: Editorial Forest
templates.tagline: Forest green, dusty pink and warm cream meet Source Serif in a quiet, intentional quarterly review.
templates.best_for: Quarterly reviews, internal readouts, studio updates and plans for the year that should feel warm and unhurried. Has slides for a five-topic agenda, a big statement, a four-step plan, three key figures and a closing with three takeaways.
templates.avoid_for: Urgent, punchy or sales-driven decks, and anything needing many slides of detail: it has only six fillable slides and a deliberately quiet rhythm.

templates.name: Soft Editorial
templates.tagline: Cormorant Garamond serif on warm cream paper with dusty pink, lemon, blush and sage cards.
templates.best_for: Research debriefs, customer-insight readouts, quarterly learnings and advisory write-ups that should feel calm and literary. Has slides for an introduction with a drop cap, a four-step method, three insights, a big statement, three key figures, a quote, three next steps, a detailed three-column finding, a five-step process, a comparison table and a closing.
templates.avoid_for: Loud launches, sales pitches and decks that need punch: the cream paper and light Cormorant serif are deliberately quiet.

templates.name: Pin & Paper
templates.tagline: Yellow paper with safety-pin drawings, ink-blue type and handwritten Caveat notes.
templates.best_for: Research findings, workshop debriefs, team plans and founder updates that should feel hand-made and personal. Has slides for a four-item agenda, three principles on pinned cards, a section divider, a detailed three-column finding, a five-step process, a comparison table, three key figures, a quote and a closing with three next steps.
templates.avoid_for: Formal board, finance or legal decks and anything that must look polished and corporate: the handwritten notes and yellow paper are informal by design.

templates.name: Signal
templates.tagline: Deep navy canvas with bone paper and a single muted-gold accent; institutional with quiet weight.
templates.best_for: Board and investor decks, consulting deliverables, strategy reviews and policy briefs, in a sober navy-and-gold style. Has slides for a section opener, a big statement, three big figures, a quote, a five-point list, a now-versus-proposed comparison, long text in two columns, a four-step process, a five-level priority stack, a four-milestone timeline, a four-step cycle and a closing.
templates.avoid_for: Playful, fast or loud decks, children's lessons and celebrations: the navy and gold restraint commits to a sober voice.

templates.name: Cobalt Grid
templates.tagline: Electric cobalt serifs on a graph-paper canvas, anchored by stair-stepped pixel-glitch decorations and slim hairline rules.
templates.best_for: Design and trend reports, studio bulletins, agency capabilities, art, architecture and curatorial decks, in a printed-ledger cobalt-on-cream style. Has slides for a big statement, six entries with short descriptions, a chapter opener with a paragraph, a quote and a closing with four footnotes.
templates.avoid_for: Data-heavy finance or sales decks and warm, playful or multi-colour topics: the strict cobalt-and-cream grid is austere by design.

templates.name: Cartesian
templates.tagline: Quiet warm-neutral palette with classical Playfair serifs; tasteful and unhurried.
templates.best_for: Investment theses, white papers, advisory work and cultural or founder talks with few words per slide, in a quiet warm-neutral style. Has slides for an agenda of four items, a big statement, three numbered cards, four phases in a row and a closing.
templates.avoid_for: Dense data decks, urgent sales pitches and playful topics: the palette is low-energy and the slides hold little text.

templates.name: 8-Bit Orbit
templates.tagline: Pixel-art neon arcade aesthetic on a deep navy void.
templates.best_for: Gaming pitches, hackathon demos, indie launches, developer tools and playful tech talks, in a neon pixel-arcade style. Has slides for a heading with two paragraphs, four feature cards, a timeline of four dated milestones, four big figures, a quote and a closing with a call to action.
templates.avoid_for: Formal finance, healthcare, legal or luxury decks: the neon arcade look will read as a costume there.

templates.name: Retro Windows
templates.tagline: Windows 95 chrome: gray title bars, MS Sans Serif, pixel typography, full nostalgia.
templates.best_for: Tongue-in-cheek team updates, tech-history talks, retro gaming and Y2K brand decks, each slide a Windows 95 window. Has slides for an agenda of ten items in two boxes, a summary with two boxed paragraphs and four facts, a four-item checklist with details and three counts, a four-quarter roadmap with three status boxes and a closing with contact details.
templates.avoid_for: Decks that must read as modern, elegant or institutionally serious: the Win95 chrome always reads as a costume.

templates.name: Long Table
templates.tagline: Warm cream and rust-red supper-club aesthetic with bold uppercase grotesk headlines, Fraunces serifs, and pill-shaped outlined buttons.
templates.best_for: Personal and social occasions: weddings, birthdays, anniversaries, dinners, supper clubs and small celebrations, in a warm, invitation-like style. Has slides for a welcome letter, three cards, event details (when, where, who, how long, price), a menu or programme of up to five numbered moments, a quote, a schedule table of up to five columns and six rows, and an RSVP closing.
templates.avoid_for: Business reviews, pitches, lessons and anything with charts or many figures: it reads as an invitation by design.

templates.name: Sakura Chroma
templates.tagline: Vintage Japanese cassette-package aesthetic: cream paper, diagonal rainbow ribbons, condensed bold type, JIS-style spec checkboxes.
templates.best_for: Travel itineraries and trip plans, holidays, school trips, tours and festival guides, in a bright retro catalogue style: a cover, a big statement, up to four days or stops side by side, a day-by-day schedule table of up to four columns and seven rows, a note, a quote and a sign-off.
templates.avoid_for: Formal business, finance or research decks, and anything sombre: the rainbow stripes and catalogue styling are playful by design.

templates.name: Neo-Grid Bold
templates.tagline: Editorial neo-brutalism with a single neon yellow accent on off-white paper.
templates.best_for: Annual and year-in-review decks, corporate results, strategy readouts and board updates that should feel bold rather than buttoned-up. Has slides for contents, a page of key figures, a section opener, a quote, three next steps, findings in three columns, a five-step process with timings and a comparison table of up to three options.
templates.avoid_for: Lessons, celebrations and quiet or warm subjects: the black, cream and neon-yellow grid is loud by design.

templates.name: Raw Grid
templates.tagline: Neo-brutalist deck with thick borders, offset shadows, and a pink/sage/ink palette.
templates.best_for: Startup and founder pitches: problem, product, traction, business model, plans and the ask. Has slides for a cover with up to seven points, a problem with two big numbers, four numbered cards, four steps, traction with four big figures, a statement with four figures, a comparison table of up to three options and a closing with contact details.
templates.avoid_for: Lessons, celebrations and anything that should feel soft, warm or quiet: the thick borders and offset shadows commit to a loud, graphic voice.

templates.name: Blue Professional
templates.tagline: Cream paper background with electric cobalt blue accents; clean modern professional.
templates.best_for: Also topic explainers for work (digital marketing, technology, business basics). Anything that should feel modern-considered and lightly authoritative: B2B SaaS pitches, consulting deliverables, advisory updates, investor reports, research synthesis and internal reviews. Has slides for an agenda of six items, three key figures with bullets, six figures, bullets beside a pull quote, a quote, a four-step roadmap, six topic cards and a closing.
templates.avoid_for: Contexts where the deck should feel hot, playful, or intentionally informal — the cool electric-blue restraint will read as overly polished.

retired_note: Out of the list until they meet designs/template-criteria (readable text, filled slides, role-marked layouts, first-try fills). Files kept in templates/.
